thread:
Sam: Quick request  can we make a tiny, copy/pasteable 15-min goal-check script for managers + IC version? Need escalation cue and async template.

Rina: Sure  sketching a super-compact set. Timing header: Start (30s) / Core (10m) / Wrap (4.5m). Emoji keys: :white_check_mark: on-track, :warning: risk, :rocket: stretch.

Omar: Draft cards:
- Set (30s): "One-sentence outcome this quarter? How will customers notice?"
- Focus (3m): "What's the single priority this sprint toward that outcome?"
- Blockers (3m): "Any blockers? What help unblock it?"
- Win (1m): "One thing that moved the needle since last time?"
- Next (1m): "One concrete next step before our next check?"

Lee: IC phrasing: change prompts to actions: "Action: ship X by Tue. Ask: review PR". Async 15s template: "Status: :white_check_mark: / :warning: ; Next: <one-liner> ; Blocker: <one-liner>"

Rina: Escalation cue (15s): "Use :warning: and cc EngLead if it blocks other teams or risk >2w. Loop PeopleOps for comp/career concerns."

PeopleOps Bot: Copied to handbook: /handbook/manager-toolkit/15min-goal-bite.md :link:

Sam: Perfect, please push to Notion and I'll ping managers in the next lead sync. Thanks! :sparkles:
